name: OpenAI-powered tweet generator
description: Generates tweets using OpenAI's language models.

setup: Setup value airtableBaseId: Airtable base id (for example appXXXX (from the base URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Workflow secret OPENAI_API_KEY: OpenAI API key for api.openai.com (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: "HTTP Request" authenticated with headerAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect airtable: `cdecli credential create -n "airtable" -p airtable --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
